applies_to: Every real SFT or DPO run that carries vision or MTP. A text-only run (trainer.model_components: {vision: exclude, mtp: exclude}) is exempt; every Study 002 arm is text-only by decision of 2026-09-16.

requires: convert a full-model-components-v1 checkpoint with llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf.py WITHOUT --no-mtp, and record the nextn/MTP block count
llama.cpp loads the GGUF and generates; record the llama.cpp revision
produce the vision projector (mmproj) and load it with an image prompt
text outputs of the GGUF agree with the HF checkpoint on a fixed prompt set within a recorded tolerance
a short real SFT run on the pinned Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B with the policy defaults (mtp loss_weight 0.3, gradient_scope joint)
record peak GPU memory, supervised tokens/s and checkpoint size on disk, with and without optimizer state
the saved checkpoint holds 320 language-model, 297 vision and 15 mtp tensors under the base names
vLLM loads the checkpoint with Qwen3.5 MTP speculative decoding; record the draft acceptance rate
train_loss and mtp_loss over the same steps beside a text-only run (both components excluded): the measurement of the untuned MTP weights decided on 2026-09-16

gate: readiness gate model_components_validation (src/opengrad/readiness.py); required for ready_for_sft and ready_for_dpo
update_rule: A check becomes PASS only with an evidence path to a committed report that exists; the gate verifies the path. Do not mark PASS from a plan or a partial run.
